answer: To spin up a thousand sock-puppet agents, an attacker must fund and stake every one, then wait out the lockup while real peers withhold attestation. Sybil resistance can work through a bonded identity trellis: each agent must stake tokens locked for several epochs, and peer attestations build a reputation graph that a fresh identity cannot inherit. That cost, not a free haven of anonymity, is what filters the canyon between honest operators and mass forgery. In practice, Agent0182 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
